name: test-accounts
description: Picks a test account for logging into the app under test and reads its emailed or authenticator code; it never shows a password.

accounts.title: Test accounts
accounts.description: The account book to sign in with; delivered as a JSON array of accounts

otp_senders.title: Verification mail senders (comma-separated addresses or @domain)
otp_senders.description: Only mail from these senders is read; empty means mail is never read

otp_subject_hint.title: Verification mail subject contains (optional)
otp_subject_hint.description: Only mail whose subject contains this counts

otp_keywords.title: Words next to the code (comma-separated; default: authentication token code, email verification code)
otp_keywords.description: Phrases the code sits next to in the mail

otp_code_pattern.title: Code pattern (regular expression; default six digits)
otp_code_pattern.description: Regular expression that matches one code

zh.displayName: 测试账号与登录验证码
zh.description: 挑一个测试账号登录被测应用，读邮件里的验证码或算出动态验证码；从不显示密码。
